load_mc_taco_dataset: load the MC-TACO temporal commonsense reasoning dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data splits for the MC-TACO dataset with configurable seed values
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with sentence question and answer fields
split_train_test_lines: split the MC-TACO validation dataset into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets using random shuffle
run_mc_taco_preprocessing: run the MC-TACO dataset preprocessing pipeline to generate multiple k-shot data splits across different random seeds
